title: Release approval
purpose: Take one change from proposal to a published release with the delivery rules of this repository: reviewed file plans, required checks with honest untested scope, an approving review and an explicitly requested publication.

roles.title: Contributor
roles.description: Proposes the change, runs the gates and reports real output.

roles.title: Maintainer
roles.description: Reviews the change and decides whether it ships.

roles.title: Release manager
roles.description: Publishes a release only when the owner explicitly asked for it.

steps.title: Propose the change
steps.description: Describe the change and confirm that every write went through a reviewed, hash-approved file plan.

fields.label: Did every write go through a reviewed, hash-approved file plan?

steps.title: Run the required checks
steps.description: Run the gates and paste their real output; a check that was not run is reported as not run, never as passed.

fields.label: Line coverage of the changed code (%)
Untested scope (write none when everything was tested)

doc.text: Suites and their purpose are listed in [[docs/testing/TEST-SUITES]]. Coverage floors come from the reviewed thresholds and may only tighten.

steps.title: Review the change
steps.description: Read the diff, the gate output and the untested scope, then decide.

steps.title: Publish the release
steps.description: Tag and publish only on the owner's explicit request; the changelog names the release.

fields.label: Did the owner explicitly request this publication?

rules.statement: Every write goes through a reviewed, hash-approved file plan.
rules.rationale: Nothing in this repository overwrites user files silently.

rules.statement: Type check, lint and the relevant test suites pass before review.
rules.rationale: Reviewers judge real gate output, not assumed success.

rules.statement: Changed feature and fix code keeps at least 90 % line coverage.
rules.rationale: The maker coverage gate never weakens; moving code does not lower its floor.

rules.statement: A dependency change runs the live security audit.
rules.rationale: An audit that was not run is reported honestly; the maintainer decides whether to continue.

rules.statement: The change states its untested scope.
An approved change has at least one approving review.
Publishing and tagging happen only when the owner explicitly requested them.

doc.text: See the safety rules in [[AGENTS]]: no task publishes, tags or submits listings unless specifically requested.

rules.statement: The release version has three dot-separated parts.
The CHANGELOG has an entry for the release.
The release links its execution record under docs/.
